answer:
Here is what I would raise at your check-up, most urgent first. These come from your records and general medical knowledge. Your records may not include tests or visits done somewhere else, so check before assuming something was missed.

1. Hydrochlorothiazide (a water pill). The hospital told you to stop it on March 5, 2026, after your sodium fell to 123. But your clinic and pharmacy records still list it as active, you reported taking it on May 14, 2026, and your sodium was low again on June 15, 2026 (134). Please call Dr. Marsh's office soon, tell them whether you are still taking it, and ask them to recheck your sodium. If you have dizziness, confusion, a fall, or feel very unwell, get care the same day.

2. Thyroid test overdue. In March your TSH was high (7.9) with a normal free T4. The hospital asked for TSH and free T4 to be repeated in 6 to 8 weeks. I see no repeat test in your records.

3. Lung nodule. The CT of October 18, 2025 found a 7 mm solid nodule in the right lower lung and recommended a chest CT in 6 to 12 months. That window ends around mid-October 2026, and I see no chest CT or other follow-up. The discharge instructions from that visit did not mention it.

4. Kidney stone follow-up. The 4 mm stone was still listed as active. The discharge instructions said to see urology if it had not passed in 2 weeks. I see no record that it passed, no urology visit, and no repeat urine test after the large amount of blood seen in your urine then.

5. Cholesterol and statin. Your September 2025 LDL was 142 and HDL was 48. You have type 2 diabetes, and no statin appears in any record. There has been no cholesterol test since. Ask whether a statin is right for you.

6. Kidney urine test for diabetes. Your kidney filtration (eGFR 71) is normal. However, I see no urine albumin test (UACR) since your diabetes diagnosis. It is usually done once a year.

7. Vaccines. Your first Shingrix dose was given on November 8, 2025. The second dose is due 2 to 6 months later, and I see none. No flu shot for the 2026-27 season is recorded yet. No tetanus booster appears anywhere in your records. Check whether you had these somewhere else.

8. Medication list cleanup. Lisinopril, which was stopped in 2025 because of cough, still shows as active in one older export. Amlodipine, losartan, metformin and Claritin each appear several times from different sources. Ask for a full medication review.

9. Screening. I see no mammogram in the last two years and no cervical screening in the last five years. Your colonoscopy in April 2019 was normal, and the next is due around 2029.

10. Good news. Your A1c has come down from 6.9% to 6.6%, and your eye exam in May 2026 showed no diabetic eye damage.
short: Most urgent: ask about hydrochlorothiazide, which the hospital stopped in March 2026 for low sodium but which is still listed as active, and sodium was low again on June 15, 2026. Also overdue or unclear: repeat TSH and free T4, a chest CT for a 7 mm lung nodule (window ends about October 2026), a urine albumin test, a statin discussion, a second Shingrix dose, and a kidney stone check.
